acceptance: 紅：指定 7 份文件的 docs_lint 目前因 freshness WARN 非零。綠：7 份均完成語意核對，指定 docs_lint exit 0、registry 仍 45/45、無 ERROR，且每份 verified_against 可由 origin/main 達到。
acceptance_cmd:
set -u
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
rc=0
./ops/docs_lint.sh --files docs/policy/safety.md docs/reference/testing/backend_strategy.md docs/reference/testing/smoke_checklist.md docs/sop/deploy.md docs/sop/ios.md docs/sop/review_discipline.md docs/runbook/system.md >"$out" 2>&1 || rc=$?
test "$rc" -eq 0 || test "$rc" -eq 3
grep -q "^ERROR: *0$" "$out"
brief: 維運與測試的活性規範已落後大量程式變更，維護者可能照過期流程執行安全、部署或驗收。
contract_evidence: Full current-main 55-ticket preflight classified this ticket executable; fix sites and acceptance command are present. Grooming did not run the stored acceptance command or implement code.
detail: 目前主線 ./ops/docs_lint.sh --audit 結果 OK 44、WARN 24、ERROR 0；registry 45/45 與 active_unregistered=0 仍健康，但多份活性 safety/testing/deploy/review/runbook 文件的 verified_against 已落後超過 30 commits。優先受影響的是 docs/policy/safety.md、backend_strategy.md、smoke_checklist.md、sop/deploy.md、sop/ios.md、sop/review_discipline.md、runbook/system.md。這不是單純把 hash 往前填：每份需先做語意核對，再更新 anchor；snapshot/archive 警告不納入本票。
plan: 1) 逐份以 registry owner/source 與目前 HEAD/origin/main 做 scope diff，找出真正語意變更，不得盲目刷新 timestamp/hash。2) 同步安全、backend test、smoke、deploy、iOS、review、system runbook 的已變更契約。3) 對每份更新 verified_against 到 origin/main 可達 commit，保留不需變更的理由。4) 跑指定 docs lint、registry lint、docs impact，並將其餘非 P1 stale docs 另列後續票或明確 disposition。
resolution: Acceptance contract corrected: docs_lint rc=3 is the documented WARN-with-zero-ERROR result; the command now accepts rc 0 or 3 and asserts ERROR: 0.
scope: 7 份 P1 safety/testing/deploy/review/runbook 文件的語意審核、verified_against 更新與 docs gate。
